subjects.name: Ten-piece press-on nail set
subjects.description: A glossy ten-piece press-on nail set composed of five distinct designs, each repeated twice: (1) black glossy base with a white five-petal flower, gold bead, and yellow petal dots; (2) amber-yellow glossy base with a raised three-dimensional arc ornament and gold bead accent; (3) glossy two-tone nail with white upper half and black lower half and a gold bead at the color boundary; (4) wine-red glossy base with a white flower or geometric motif, black polka dots, and gold bead; (5) white glossy base with a raised pink three-dimensional flower and gold bead. When worn, the pieces sit at the cuticle following the natural fingernail curve at medium almond length, mapped one piece per finger.
